description: Read and change the order of existing mail accounts without changing the default account.

functions.name: getOrder
functions.description: Return IDs in the same order and with the same account types as accounts.list(false). Hidden and non-mail accounts are excluded.

functions.name: setOrder
functions.description: Persist a complete permutation of the current mail account IDs. Invalid or stale membership rejects before mutation. Non-mail and hidden accounts are preserved; the default account is unchanged. Read getOrder again after an error.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Every ID returned by a fresh getOrder call, exactly once, in the desired order.
